messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a big spike of span drops from eu-prod ~12:40. Kibana shows exporter timeouts and stream resets.
chris: saw it too. collector logs: TLS handshake delays then gRPC stream resets. Lots of retries backoffed out.
jordan: Is this related to the new pathfinder routing flip? we moved eu traffic to aggregator-2 yesterday.
maya: yeah, suspect routing + keepalive defaults. Defaults seem too aggressive for intermittent VPN latency.
sara: we should add an HTTP/protobuf fallback for short windows instead of failing the batch. right now it's grpc-only.
chris: +1. proposal: primary gRPC with 1.5s deadline, 3 retries with exponential backoff+jitter, then one 500ms HTTP fallback attempt.
leo: need to avoid double-ingestion — fallback must set an idempotency header or use a single-writer token so we don't duplicate.
maya: also throttle retries per-tenant using a token-bucket in the exporter. noisy tenants currently kill the pipeline.
jordan: ```yaml
exporter:
  protocol: grpc
  deadline_ms: 1500
  retry_policy:
    attempts: 3
    initial_backoff_ms: 200
    max_backoff_ms: 2000
    jitter: 0.2
  fallback_http: true
  fallback_deadline_ms: 500
  idempotency_header: "x-telemetry-id"
  per_tenant_token_bucket:
    capacity: 1000
    refill_ms: 1000
```
chris: also add a circuit breaker: open after 10 consecutive failures for 1m, with exponential cooldown. emit metric exporter.circuit_open.
sara: UX question — rollout strategy: console toggle per-cluster or per-route? we need canary + auto-rollback if error rate rises.
maya: console idea: 'telemetry export policy' config with canary percent + dashboards. start with 1% canary for eu-prod.
jordan: also annotate spans with exporter decision (grpc | http_fallback | dropped) and retry counts for debugging.
leo: @infra-bot can you create an alert: exporter.failure_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page? add suppression during canary.
infra-bot: Alert created: ENG-OTLP-FAIL-01. Pager rule: severity=page, suppression=label:canary
chris: I'll PR token-bucket + circuit logic. @maya can you add dashboard panels (per-tenant failure rate, fallback ratio, avg export latency)?
maya: on it. adding panels and an annotation for rollout start. will post links when ready.
sara: :thumbsup: plan looks good. if anyone sees spikes during canary let's pause rollout and investigate.
